svg.text: The system of record for money: accounts, transactions, statements, budgets, bills and the Dashboard. Java 21, Spring Boot, jOOQ. Row-Level Security is forced on every table.
dev: Lambda · prod: Fargate behind internal ALB
Transactions: list, approve, edit, split, tag, exclude, manual entry
Import (internal): one call per statement, idempotent
Budgets: monthly lines, templates, quick start, spend
Bills: this month's bills, mark paid
closed budgets are read-only; reopen is explicit
event exists if and only if the change commits
creates the statement record and returns a
presigned S3 URL; the client uploads directly
